name: barbell squat to shoulder press
description: A squat that flows straight into an overhead press. It trains legs and shoulders together in one fluid rep.
instructions: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly forward and feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your heels and use that momentum to press the bar overhead.
Lock out the press with the bar over your mid-foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Keep your core braced the whole time and avoid arching your lower back.
